profile.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer / SDET
profile.primary_domain: Software Quality Engineering and Test Automation

linkedin_summary.headline: Over 5 years of professional experience in technology and software quality with a technical profile and a focus on delivering reliable products, combining a risk-driven mindset, close collaboration with teams, and hands-on experience in Test Automation and DevOps.
linkedin_summary.overal_experience_summary: Throughout my career, I've contributed to product quality across web, desktop, and API applications through functional, exploratory, integration, and regression testing, retesting, SQL database validation, and API testing, always aiming to catch risks before they reached the user. I've also evolved and built automation projects from the ground up, automated manual processes, integrated internal tools, built automated execution pipelines, mentored QA professionals, and built test automation frameworks, for example, cutting a desktop regression cycle from around six hours to one, making regression cycles faster, more reliable, and more sustainable for the teams.
linkedin_summary.my_profile_motivations_wayofwork: I'm motivated by contributing solutions that deliver real value. I collaborate with developers, QA, and product to identify quality risks from planning and requirements definition through development, delivery, and post-release monitoring, helping investigate defects down to their root cause when something doesn't go as expected. I also build automation that reduces repetitive tasks, scales with the product, is easy to adopt and maintain, and brings reliability to new releases. I value delivering with intention, quality, and collaboration at every stage.
linkedin_summary.main_technologies: I mainly work with Python, Java, Robot Framework, Cypress, Postman, Docker, Jenkins, and Linux, and I have a genuine interest in learning and building new technologies or solutions that can make a difference and solve real day-to-day problems.
linkedin_summary.my_goal: I'm looking to keep growing as a QA Engineer with the long-term goal of becoming an SDET, combining deep software quality expertise with the technical ability to tackle larger engineering problems.
linkedin_summary.interests: My current interests include Software Quality, Non-Functional Testing, Test Automation, CI/CD, and Observability applied to quality.

profile.long_professional_summary: I have over 5 years of experience in Technology and Software Quality, with progressive growth across DevOps, QA Engineering, and Test Automation, achieving the position of Senior Test Automation Engineer. I have hands-on experience designing, developing, and evolving test automation projects for web, desktop, and API applications, as well as creating and maintaining automated tests, primarily using Python, Cypress, Robot Framework, Postman, Newman, and SQL. I have built test frameworks from scratch, maintained projects with over 400 E2E tests, applied Page Object Model (POM), Data-Driven Testing, tag-based execution, API automation, and integrated tests into CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins. I also have experience with Docker, Linux, Ansible, Allure Report generation, and developing automations and integrations in Python. My work extends beyond test execution—I bring a technical mindset, critical thinking, and a product quality focus. I strive to understand requirements, business rules, critical flows, and ways to contribute to reliable deliverables that meet user expectations and team needs, always collaborating effectively and driving results. I value combining Software Quality and DevOps perspectives, expanding coverage, accelerating feedback, and increasing release reliability, with a constant focus on anticipating and preventing issues, supporting decisions, and delivering value.
